cutscene.ch01.01.001: Your Majesty! You mustn't! That front has already collapsed! You need to retreat to the rear while there's still time!
cutscene.ch01.01.002: If I retreat, who will protect the people beyond that line?
cutscene.ch01.01.003: But that monster is too dangerous! Thousands have fought it, and none could bring it down!
cutscene.ch01.01.004: That is precisely why I must go. Someone has to stand before it.
cutscene.ch01.01.006: A crown is not worn to protect one's own life.
